expect.def: to cycle, to ride a bike

def: To ride a bicycle. It is written as two words with Rad capitalised, because Rad is still the noun: you say ich fahre Rad, never ich radfahre. The one-word spelling radfahren was correct before the 1996 reform and is now wrong.
src: ruling: the gloss already says "to cycle"; the definition should carry what the gloss cannot — the spelling and the word order
